jobs.jd:
Strong organic search performance depends on consistent research, monitoring and testing. For the French market, that means understanding how people search, how competitors appear in search results and where content can perform better. At idealo, you will support our France SEO work with research, reporting and hands-on optimisation tasks while learning SEO through real projects. You will work closely with an experienced SEO manager and contribute to projects around Google Search, content and emerging search technologies. When your research helps uncover an optimisation opportunity, you can see how your work feeds directly into improvements on idealo.fr.

About your new role

  • Monitor SEO performance and support recurring reporting for idealo.fr.

  • Research competitors, search results and developments in the French market.

  • Support keyword research, content optimisation and SEO testing.

  • Prepare analyses for important French commercial and sales events.

  • Keep SEO documentation, meeting notes and project follow-ups up to date.



Skills & Requirements

Must-have

  • You are currently studying marketing, business, digital or a related field.

  • You speak French fluently and communicate confidently in English.

  • You are comfortable working with data, spreadsheets and online research.

  • You take ownership and independently drive topics forward.

Nice-to-have

  • You enjoy tackling challenges actively and solving them pragmatically.
